definition: Provides information about the CA entitlement.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

RecordDate.definition: Date on which the holders of securities are/will be recorded for the income being paid or for entitlement to the rights or offer/privilege.

AccountAndDistributionDetails.name: Account And Distribution Details
AccountAndDistributionDetails.definition: Provides information about the entitlement and the entitled account.
